items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I worked with Jon in “Evolution of the Blues,” that was in the seventies also.

ctx.x: Well I see one of my other favorite people on here and that is Jon Hendricks.

Oh boy, yeah. Now Jon Hendricks is a true living genius. I worked with Jon in “Evolution of the Blues,” that was in the seventies also. And I’ll never forget one episode with Jon, there was some kind of tension between the dancers and Jon and whatever, anyway it ended up I sort of sided with the dancers. And Jon, it was sort of like a walk- out. And there was like a musician/dancer strike, like that. So we said we weren’t going to do the show until certain demands were met. Jon said, “Well I’ll do the show…
Yeah. He’s very articulate and spiritual. © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
